item.title: One Attacker Has Scraped Both Salesforce and ServiceNow Portals Since 2025
item.summary: A single piece of infrastructure has been pulling records out of Salesforce and ServiceNow customer portals across multiple industries for more than a year, according to research published this week by agent security platform Reco.
